messages:
sam_releases: kicking off canary for v3.4.0-rc2 in eu-west-1 — deploybot preflight returned an eval-gate failure on the summarizer prompt set, holding deployment until we triage.

marta_qa: can you paste the eval summary? quick glance numbers pls — is this regressions-on-edge-cases or systemic?

DeployBot: preflight results:
```
suite: summarizer_prompt_v2
baseline: v3.3.9
candidate: v3.4.0-rc2
mean_quality_delta: -5.3%
hallucination_rate_delta: +2.1%
coverage_drop_pct: 4.7%
failing_examples: 23/500 (clustered around long-context bullets)
trigger: automated_quality_gate(threshold=-3%)
status: HOLD_APPLIED (canary halted)
```

dana_prod: yikes. those numbers look systemic enough. propose we hold rollout and run a targeted bisect on the last quant/compile changes. @ivan_model can you start a local reproduce with the same prompt set?

ken_sre: +1 hold. also flagging routing: if we keep traffic routed to eu-west canary, we should reduce traffic to zero until bisect completes to avoid user impact.

ivan_model: investigating now — initial run shows candidate's KV-cache allocator path had a rounding change in q4_2 kernels. Reproduced 2 failing cases locally. ETA ~35-45m for a minimal repro and a bisect candidate.

ops_beth: thanks — I'm pausing the canary traffic and updating the runbook. leaving the canary hold in place. ops note: change-window still open for another 3h, but we should not push more units until fixed.

sam_releases: decision: hold + bisect. do NOT roll back globally yet; prefer to confirm the minimal repro and try a rollback-on-failure if bisect shows no quick fix. tagging @nina_pm for product signoff on holding window.

nina_pm: OK to hold. impact assessment from PM side: degraded summarizer quality is visible in critical flows, hold approved. please link the failing example set in the ticket.

ivan_model: uploaded repro bundle to the release ticket and kicked off a bisect job (`bisect-run 2832109876 --range=HEAD~6..HEAD`). first suspect is commit `a7f3c9f` (quant kernel tweak). If we can patch the kernel fallback to previous allocator behavior, we can run quick smoke.

dana_prod: if patch looks small, prefer fast patch + canary smoke rather than full rollback. otherwise plan B: rollback canary to v3.3.9 and promote hotfix branch.

DeployBot: canary traffic set to 0% by ops_beth. Hold reason: quality_gate(summary) exceeded threshold. Audit log: https://ci.internal/release/2832109876/preflight

sam_releases: thanks everyone — leaving thread open. will update when bisect finishes or if we need to flip to rollback plan. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
